# democraft-mcp - llms-full.txt

## What
`craft(operation, app, demo, model, prompt, confirm)` portmanteau over 13
Craft apps (cad, deck, design, effect, fig, film, grid, sound, word, pdf,
light, photo, vector). Ops: list_apps, app_status, run_demo, craft_commands,
ollama_models, ai_flow, help, shutdown. Prefab: show_apps_prefab_card,
show_demo_prefab_card. Prompt: democraft_demo_guide(app).

## How demos run
`run_demo` (src/democraft_mcp/crafts.py): AI step via Ollama
`DEMOCRAFT_MODEL` (default gemma4:e4b, declared skip when down), then real
CLI subprocess (`CLI_TIMEOUT_S=120`) into `outbox/<app>/<demo>/`. Returns
`{success, message, ai_step, cli_steps, artifacts, all_cli_ok, run_dir}`.
Errors: unknown_app, wrappee_missing, needs_account, needs_input, timeout, spawn - always
with recovery text. Per-app argv: cad scripted metric plan + south elevation
(DXF/PNG/PDF/SVG) + info, deck render --sample, design run --sample,
effect openDemoProject + render-frame still, fig newFromTemplate + render,
film single-session run (openDemoProject + exportEdl), grid csv->xlsx->cat + eval,
sound demo inspect + full-groove bounce + info, word md->docx->pdf + info,
pdf combine + render + info, light commands map + develop run (needs grade-in.png),
photo/vector AI SVG (12-20 shapes, end-tag parsed) + convert/run.

## REST
GET /api/health + /health, /api/status, /api/capabilities, /api/crafts,
POST /api/demos/run, /api/runs, /api/tools, /api/skills, /api/logs,
/api/llm/discover+providers+models+onboarding, POST /api/llm/chat + /api/chat,
POST /api/shutdown (confirm). MCP at /mcp (path=/ mount + lifespan).
CORS localhost + LAN/Tauri regex. Backend :11246, frontend :11245.

## Webapp
web_sota/: AppLayout sidebar+topbar, Dashboard/Inbox/Tools/Skills/Chat/
Settings/Help/Logs + Craft/:app dynamic domain pages fed by /api/crafts.
Zustand stores (llm, backend), data-testid on controls, MOCK badges until
wrappee installed. Onboarding CTA under hero per ONBOARDING_STANDARD.

## Scaffolding truth
FastMCP 3.4.4+ (<4), prefab-ui core, uv+just+ruff, bun webapp, pytest
(real CLIs, tmp outbox), Windows CI + just ci, MCPB (wipe+recopy,
3-4-100 prompts), ports claimed (11246/11245).
